'''Formats''' are the organized-play card pools and event types used for ''Star Wars'' CCG tournaments and casual games. Decipher-era play used printed cards under Decipher rules. After Decipher ended the game, the [[Players Committee]] added virtual cards and labeled constructed environments (notably '''Standard''' after the 2014 Virtual Card Reset, and '''Legacy''' for the pre-reset virtual pool).

This page is a short index. It does '''not''' replace official tournament documents. Full format definitions, banned lists, and event procedures live on [https://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org] and in the PDFs linked below.

== Constructed (Players Committee) ==

Constructed events use pre-built decks. The Players Committee ''Alternate Format Tournament Guide'' (revised September 2015) describes two primary constructed pools:<ref name="afg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Alternate-Formats-Guide.pdf Star Wars CCG Alternate Format Tournament Guide] (revised 09/2015), Players Committee</ref>

* '''Standard''' - Decipher cards plus the post-2014 "reset" / current Virtual Set cards (slanted-ring virtual set icon). Described there as the usual championship-circuit constructed environment, including Worlds.<ref name="afg" />
* '''[[Legacy Open|Legacy]]''' - Decipher cards plus Legacy Virtual Cards from before the Fall 2014 reset (black-diamond virtual block icon). The [[2014 World Championship]] was the last championship circuit to use that pool.<ref name="afg" />

Some later PC articles and events also say '''Open''' for constructed decks that include Virtual Cards and Shields.<ref name="wend-open">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/wends-world-thematic-deck-match-ups-series-1/ Wend's World - Thematic Deck Match-ups Series (#1)], starwarsccg.org</ref> This wiki does not equate "Open" with "Standard"; use the event's own wording and linked docs.

Deck construction size and "outside the deck" cards (for example Defensive Shields under a Starting Effect) follow the tournament document in force for the event; see the Tournament Guide and [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]].

Virtual set hubs on this wiki: [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Current Virtual sets]] (Standard-era) and [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Legacy sets]] (pre-reset).

== Limited / sealed and draft ==

Sealed and booster-draft events use unopened product (or a fixed cube pool) instead of a full constructed library. The same Alternate Format Tournament Guide lists product-specific sealed and draft variants (examples: Premiere Sealed, Official Tournament Sealed Deck sealed/draft, Enhanced Premiere Pack Overdrive, Death Star II sealed/draft, Reflections booster draft, Secret Squirrel) and '''Watto's Cube''' (a fixed ~450-card draft pool).<ref name="afg" /> Cube details and the official cube list are maintained by the Players Committee at [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cube/ starwarsccg.org/cube].


== Decipher-era constructed pools ==

Decipher Worlds used the printed sets legal at the time, from [[Premiere]] through the newest expansion. [[Decipher deck designs]] used the same rule for the publication month:

* [[Premiere]] — May–June 1996 Deck Designs
* [[Premiere - A New Hope]] — [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]; July–November 1996 Deck Designs
* [[Premiere - Hoth]] — early 1997 Deck Designs (through April)
* [[Premiere - Dagobah]] — mid 1997 Deck Designs; [[1997 Kiffex Regionals]]; [[1997 Sullust Regionals]]
* [[Premiere - Cloud City]] — [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]
* [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] — 1998 Deck Designs (through October)
* [[Premiere - Special Edition]] — [[1998 Decipher World Championship]]
* [[Premiere - Endor]] — [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]
* [[Premiere - Death Star II]] — [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]; also [[2021 Retro Event (Premiere to Death Star II)]] and later GEMP Retro / Premiere-to-DSII events
* [[Premiere - Tatooine]] — [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]]
* [[Premiere - Coruscant]] — printed Decipher through [[Coruscant]]
* [[Premiere - Reflections II]] — [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Premiere through Reflections II)
* [[Premiere - Reflections III]] — [[2001 Decipher World Championship]]
* [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] — [[2022 Decipher Cards Only Retro Event]] (GEMP environment name '''Decipher Cards Only''')

Later Players Committee events also use [[Open]], [[Legacy Open]], [[Jawa Format]], [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] (Decipher Cards Only), [[Premiere - Original VS1]] (March 2002), [[Premiere - Original VS3]] (2002), [[Premiere - Original VS13]] (2007), [[Premiere - Original VS16]] (2008), and (for the 2025 charity event) [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]].

== Original Virtual constructed (2002–2009) ==

From March 2002 until the September 2009 Block reorganization, championship constructed was printed Decipher cards plus the original numbered Virtual Sets that were legal on the event date. Each cutoff is its own format hub, titled '''Premiere - Original VS{N}''' (short redirect '''POVS{N}'''). Legal days live on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].

* [[Premiere - Original VS1]] (redirect [[POVS1]]) — printed Decipher through [[Theed Palace]] plus original Virtual Set 1. Legal 9 March 2002. Used on [[Game Players Network decks]] from that day.
* [[Premiere - Original VS3]] (redirect [[POVS3]]) — printed Decipher through [[Theed Palace]] plus original Virtual Sets 1–3. Used for the [[2002 World Championship]].
* [[Premiere - Original VS13]] (redirect [[POVS13]]) — printed Decipher through [[Theed Palace]] plus original Virtual Sets 1–13, including [[Defensive Shields]]. Used for the [[2007 World Championship]].
* [[Premiere - Original VS16]] (redirect [[POVS16]]) — printed Decipher through [[Theed Palace]] plus original Virtual Sets 1–16, including [[Defensive Shields]]. Used for the [[2008 World Championship]].

This pool is not [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]] (2025 current-virtual retro) and not the GEMP environment named '''Premiere - Virtual Set 3'''.

== Legacy Virtual constructed (2009–2014) ==

After the 2009 Block reorganization, championship constructed used the pre-reset Virtual Block pool. Full-pool championships dest as [[Legacy Open]] (the [[2014 World Championship]] was the last circuit event in that pool). A tighter Block cutoff dests as '''Premiere - Virtual Block {N}''' when a source names that cutoff.

== GEMP environments ==

[https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com] (this wiki's GEMP table) and the Players Committee GEMP table expose named constructed '''environments''' that limit the legal set pool. Names below are taken from the GEMP format list (<code>swccgFormats.json</code>) and from published PC event pages. Historical original-virtual cutoffs use the Premiere - Original VS{N} titles above.

* [[Premiere - Hoth]] (<code>premiere_hoth</code>) &mdash; Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Hoth]]. Used for early 1997 Deck Designs.
* [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (<code>premiere_dagobah</code>) &mdash; Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Dagobah]]. Used for the [[1997 Kiffex Regionals]] and [[1997 Sullust Regionals]].
* [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (<code>premiere_jp</code>) &mdash; Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Jabba's Palace]]. Used for 1998 Deck Designs.
* [[Premiere - Tatooine]] (<code>premiere_tatooine</code>) &mdash; Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Tatooine]]. Used for the [[2001 Brugge Belgian Open]].
* [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (<code>premiere_ds2</code>) &mdash; Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Death Star II]] (GEMP set ids 1&ndash;9 and matching premium/reflections ids as configured on the table). Used for the [[2021 Retro Event (Premiere to Death Star II)]] and the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].
* [[Premiere - Reflections II]] &mdash; printed Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Reflections II]]. Used for the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]].
* [[Open]] &mdash; current virtual constructed environment (Decipher cards plus current Virtual Sets and Shields). Used for the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]].
* [[Legacy Open]] (<code>legacy</code>) &mdash; Decipher cards plus pre-reset Virtual Block cards. Used for the [[2014 World Championship]].
* [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] (<code>open_no_virtual</code>, GEMP name '''Decipher Cards Only''') &mdash; Decipher sets from [[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]. Used for the [[2022 Decipher Cards Only Retro Event]].
* Premiere - Virtual Set 3 (<code>premiere_set3</code>) &mdash; Decipher cards plus '''current''' Virtual Sets through Virtual Set 3. Distinct from [[Premiere - Original VS3]] (2002 original slips) and from [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]] (the 2025 charity event that uses this current-virtual pool).
* [[Anything Goes]] — intended default Casual and AI environment on this instance (constructed collection, all sets, 40–60 cards). Further work is listed on [[GEMP planned features]].

Other GEMP environment names exist on the table; add stub pages here only when a PC or GEMP source names them for a documented event.

== Other labeled formats ==

The Players Committee maintains additional constructed and casual formats under the '''SWCCG Formats''' menu on [https://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org] (examples with dedicated pages: [[Jawa Format]] ([https://www.starwarsccg.org/jawa/ PC page]), [https://www.starwarsccg.org/utinni/ Utinni!], [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cube/ Watto's Chance Cube]). Full definitions, banned lists, and version notes stay on those PC pages - this wiki does not copy them here. Other menu entries (for example 100 Card Deck Format, Limited Resources, Scavenger Format) are listed on the PC site; add wiki one-liners only after citing those pages.

Closed-environment and themed constructed variants described in the Alternate Format Tournament Guide (Classic, Episode I Closed Environment, Battle of Endor Environment, team events, The Bith Shuffle, and others) are likewise defined in that PDF rather than on this page.<ref name="afg" />
